method: B19 H2-compatible synthetic priority-flood minimax barrier routing. Four-neighbor shoreline cells seed 8-neighbor reachability and parent tree; every cell reaches one coastline root. This is NOT certified steepest-slope D8 and does not model measured lakes or streams.

rainfall_scenarios.coastal_moist: coast 1.35, farthest inland 0.65 by 8-neighbor shoreline distance
rainfall_scenarios.interior_moist: coast 0.65, farthest inland 1.35 by same distance

qualifications: Not real elevation, km², rain mm, river discharge, climatic seasons, or real runoff
Each ocean-adjacent grid cell is independent experimental outlet; tiny basins are frequent
No officially mapped nations, lakes, rivers, marshes, bays, tectonic plates, or geography
The H1 model cannot replace the confirmed Resistance Arc, south-open inner sea, R1/R2 positional geography
B16 coastal outlines unchanged. Cell size is display-grid unit and differs by model sheet.
Comparisons across sheets are counts and pattern only, not real physical area or volume
